pose_constraints.posture: Strictly vertical 'Pillar' orientation. Standing firmly with the head tilted slightly up to present the horns.
pose_constraints.orientation: 0-degree head-on frontal view. Symmetrical and centered.
pose_constraints.camera_angle: Medium-low angle. This makes the two brow horns the highest vertical points, stretching the silhouette upward.
pose_constraints.body_logic: Width is kept to 310px. The round frill acts as the background for the face. The front legs are positioned close together to keep the base narrow.
pose_constraints.framing_note: The three horns (two long brow horns, one short nose horn) must be fully in-frame and clearly defined against the sky.

character_details.expression: Brave and steadfast; a determined but friendly 'guardian' look. Large, clear eyes.
character_details.texture: Clean, matte-satin skin with subtle, large-scale pebble textures (graphic, not gritty). No 'fat' folds—just solid, heroic muscle.
character_details.colors: Slate-blue body with a vibrant sunset-orange gradient on the top of the frill. The horns are a polished, light-ivory color.
features: Powerful, parrot-like beak with clean edges.

environmental_details.ground: Simple, lush green grass with a few stylized, oversized clover leaves.
flora: Tall, thin prehistoric conifers in the distant background to reinforce the vertical pillar shape.
environmental_details.lighting: Clear, bright 'Hero' lighting from the front-left. Deep, clean blue shadows to give the head 3D volume.
